strategy: FLOW STILL COMPOSITION -> VEO 3.1 8S MOTION SEED -> 30FPS MOTION TEMPLATE EXTRACTION -> LOCAL PROCEDURAL LONG LOOP -> MUSIC-SECTION PLACEMENT

why.reason: Use Veo as a motion teacher; reuse learned motion fields locally instead of spending credits for every song/background.

flow_image_rules.camera: locked or extremely slow cinematic viewpoint
flow_image_rules.preferred: our-generated image or rights-cleared source; final image stored with source/rights metadata

veo_8s_rules.camera: locked; no cuts; no whip pan; no zoom burst
veo_8s_rules.audio: not required for hymn background seed
veo_8s_rules.first_last_frame: use when it improves loop continuity; reject if it creates unnatural reverse/hold
veo_8s_rules.extend: optional only after explicit credit approval
prompt_requirements: natural phenomenon is the only moving subject
movement remains gentle enough for lyrics
no text, logo, person, animal close-up unless the category is BIRDS_FLYING
no sudden lightning/flashing unless specific storm template and lyric-safe test passes
begin and end in visually compatible states

phenomena_priority.motion: steady downward flow; avoid hyper-fast spray
slow droplets; dark safe text zone

worship_background_rules.section_change_policy: KEEP ONE FAMILY; change only on deliberate major musical/emotional shift
worship_background_rules.motion_distraction_limit: If motion is noticed more than lyrics by normal viewing, reject.
worship_background_rules.idle_mode: When no song plays, rotate approved ambient loops every 20-45s with 1.0-2.0s crossfade; never show lyrics.
worship_background_rules.song_mode: MUSIC_TEACHER timing becomes authoritative; idle visual rotation pauses.

source_lessons: Worship backgrounds typically work as subtle loops rather than attention-grabbing video.
Nature is strongest for creation, peace, prayer and reflective moments.
One visual family per song is usually better than frequent mid-song switching.
